protocol.omissions: JVX, JVS and JVC are outside the focused timing comparison; existing all-solver results are preserved. JVX remains a required-memory reference. JVHYBRID shares the finite-limit Rust path.
protocol.pairing: Four deterministic input matrices per timing case, shared by all methods. Input arrays are reused across threshold/structure levels and exact transposes across orientations.
protocol.large_optional_limit: L=2/max(N,M), chosen before timing to retain rejection-active inputs as size grows; actual cardinalities are recorded.
protocol.timing: Validation, data generation and calibration are outside timing. Nine shuffled rounds include adapters and output construction; each method uses a calibrated block targeting 30 ms.
protocol.budgets: Methods projected to require more than 240 timing seconds are excluded before rounds; methods exceeding that budget mid-run retain partial samples but have no summary. Whole-case wall timeout is 1200 seconds. All omissions remain explicit in method_status.json and logs.
protocol.memory: Five fresh processes per full condition, single CPU and one library thread. Resident float64 input prepared before baseline. High-water increments, baseline headroom and exact transformed-buffer sizes are recorded separately. Memory orientations use distribution-matched independent arrays to avoid a pre-baseline transpose allocation.
